name: Tyler Hoffman
action: Tyler hesitates, gripping the phone, then says, "Um—I can't. I've got class at eight."
reason: The coordinator's request directly threatens the phlebotomy class Tyler has been anticipating all week, and his activated concern about finally sticking with something real outweighs the guilt he feels about leaving Roy uncovered. His first impulse to decline wins out, though the brief hesitation reflects the competing pull to be dependable. The automatic assumption that the coordinator expects an easy yes makes him push back rather than cave, and he gives the most immediate, honest reason available.
